description: Inputs that the strict reader accepts, with their canonical bytes and hashes: white space, scalars, empty containers, the order of members, escapes, nesting, the worked example of conventions.md and the edge files of the evidence for the decisions.

cases.description: The worked example of conventions.md (Serialisation).
White space of every kind around every token.
A string at the top level.
An empty string.
true at the top level.
false at the top level.
Zero at the top level.
Negative zero is written as 0.
An empty object.
An empty array.
Empty containers inside containers.
Keys sorted by code unit: digits, upper case, '_' and lower case, with a prefix first.
Members of nested objects are sorted too.
Arrays keep their order.
Sorting ignores language: 'peach', 'péché', 'pêche' and 'sin' in code point order.
Escapes written as two characters.
Every control character from U+0001 to U+001F.
U+007F, U+0080, U+009F, U+2028, U+2029 and U+FEFF are written as UTF-8.
An escaped solidus is written as '/'.
An escape in capital letters.
An escaped and a raw 'é' give the same bytes.
A character outside the BMP from a surrogate pair is written as UTF-8.
Quotation marks and backslashes.
In the plain mode, keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 (D83D DE00) before U+FF08.
